name: Creatine topical

lead: Topical creatine is the energy-metabolism compound creatine applied in skin creams. Skin loses firmness with age as collagen breaks down and fibroblasts slow; creatine is proposed to help by supporting cell energy.
A 2026 review found that clinical studies on skin firmness are limited, while lab and in vivo work suggests topical creatine increases elasticity and firmness and gives photoprotective benefits.

paras: It is included in cosmetic creams and serums at product-specified concentrations and applied to skin as part of an anti-ageing routine; oral creatine is a separate use.
The review reports minimal risk at recommended doses; as with any skincare ingredient, patch-testing and product labels apply.

chain: Creatine supports cell energy in skin
angle.text: In skin-care products creatine is used to support firmness and elasticity and to protect against photodamage.

lead: Creatine is a naturally occurring compound central to cellular energy metabolism. A 2026 review in the Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology examined topical and oral creatine for skin firmness and resilience.[1]

The review notes that skin firmness declines with intrinsic ageing, environmental damage and oxidative stress, as collagen degrades and fibroblasts become dysfunctional, weakening the extracellular matrix.[1] It reports that clinical studies on creatine and skin firmness are limited, but in vivo and in vitro research suggests topical creatine enhances elasticity and firmness and offers photoprotection with minimal risk at recommended doses; no direct studies of oral creatine and skin firmness were found.[1]
Creatine is also widely discussed on T Nation as a gym supplement, a separate use.

paras: Creatine supports cellular energy; the review proposes this benefits fibroblasts and the extracellular matrix.[1]

A 2026 review reports clinical studies of creatine on skin firmness are limited; supportive findings come from in vivo and in vitro work, and no direct studies of oral creatine and skin firmness were found.[1]
